advisories.hint: layout.json "frame.widthRatio" carries no measurement — the target's surround reads as one ink-outlined band whose left/right members are the same brick tone as the wall: a side width cannot be separated from the wall at 19 px of pane (astra-audit C2). Measure it off a crop the owner ratifies, or drop the key.. Nothing gates this dimension; do not read a number into the silence.

layout.json "frame.proud" carries no measurement — how far the frame stands in FRONT of the brick is a depth along z; one elevation of a flat-shaded still carries no z for a 0.05 m feature. r2 read it off a lit inner face, which is a shading cue, not a measurement.. Nothing gates this dimension; do not read a number into the silence.

layout.json "cornice.projection" carries no measurement — the target's crown reads as ONE coping band; no cornice course projects far enough to separate from it in the still. r2's 0.02 W was already marked UNVERIFIED.. Nothing gates this dimension; do not read a number into the silence.

layout.json "landing.depth" carries no measurement — a deck's depth projects as d*sin(phi)*mZ of vertical band, inseparable at this resolution from the deck fascia and the railing feet inside the same band (fable-audit L6: the decks are open grilles). r2's 0.15 W was already flagged UNVERIFIED and stays out of the gate.. Nothing gates this dimension; do not read a number into the silence.
